authorization: User requested a dashboard like GGR, limited to DG leads and deals, specified source Заявка с ДГ, example lead 54999 and GitHub path gg&dg. Existing ROP semantics retained; no new revenue, payment or period conversion definitions introduced.

population.leads: SOURCE_ID = UC_NQ3QUI, all available history and directions
population.deals: SOURCE_ID = UC_NQ3QUI OR LEAD_ID in eligible leads; unique deal ID; all categories; linked-only attribution labeled

period: Inclusive calendar dates in Europe/Moscow; internally equivalent to [from 00:00, dayAfterTo 00:00). Each entity filtered by its own creation date. Current day explicitly partial.
conversion: Current converted status of selected creation-date lead cohort / all leads of same cohort; no fixed maturation window; denominator and n shown. Not deals created during period / leads during period.
money: CRM OPPORTUNITY grouped by CURRENCY_ID for currently open deals created in selected period. This is pipeline, not paid revenue. Missing amount is null, not zero; explicit CRM zero shown as zero. No inferred payments, returns, gross/net accounting or forecasts.
manager: Current assigned user ID, separately for each lead and deal. Retain inactive owners. No whole-department plan or communications metrics.
freshness: Collector reads CRM on existing Pages deployment. Timestamp shows source collection time. >24h visibly stale; failed collector fails deployment before publication; no partial output.
privacy: Allowlisted operational fields only; exclude client names, titles, phone, email, address, comments, messages, task subjects and credentials.
verificationLimit: Live CRM read and older ROP snapshot are same source family. No external financial reconciliation claimed or needed for a CRM count/pipeline view. Lead 54999 is the user-provided example. Other numeric semantics are inherited from the requested reference.
